arm_b.appended_text:
FROZEN EXPERIMENTAL SYNTACTIC PREDICATE-CARRIER GUIDANCE:

For the action slot, identify the lexical verbal head that functions as the clause's governing predicate. If an auxiliary or modal governs that lexical verb, the governed lexical verb remains the action candidate. Do not promote a noun or nominalized event inside that verb's complement to action merely because it denotes an activity. Keep such nominal material in the object or complement unless the literal clause structure itself makes it the governing predicate. This is a source-syntactic carrier rule only. Do not infer or emit normative force.
